Dādaṃbhaṭṭa
son of Nārāyaṇa.
--C. Siddhāntabhāṣya on Āśvalāyanaśrautasūtra. BISM. thi. 648 (ch. 3). [Page002-b] a. given a. Dādam Bhaṭṭa here; written by Siddhāntin. See NCC. II. p. 226b.

Dādā_Karajgi
son of Mādhava, grandson of Nṛsim3ha; pupil of Kṛṣṇācārya an. follower of Madhva; belonged to Vasiṣṭhagotra; resident of Nasik. See Kane, HDS. I. p.. 558. 702.
--Dattārka. dh. composed in 1769 A. D. (Śaka 1691). Bu7hler 557.

Dādājī_Aṣṭaka
Jain. (Beg. namAmyahaM zrIjinadattasUriM). C.. X.

Dādāpārśvanāthastuti
Jain. in 9 verses. in praise of Pārśvanātha of Baroda; by Kalyāṇasāgarasūri of Añcala gaccha.

(9) of 1891-95. BORI. D. XIX. i. 247.

verses. (Beg. zrIazvasenanararAjapavitraputraH) on Pārśvanātha of Baroda; by Rājasundara; incorporates the first line of Bhaktāmarastotra a. the last line.
